title: 7 Best Herbal Creams For Overeating
intro: Herbal creams for overeating are topical preparations made from plant extracts that aim to reduce cravings and promote a sense of fullness. The benefits of using herbal creams to treat overeating include reducing stress and anxiety, which are often triggers for overeating, as well as providing a natural and non-invasive approach to managing weight. Examples of herbal creams used to treat overeating include peppermint oil, which has a calming effect on the digestive system, and ginger oil, which can help to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. Additionally, creams containing extracts from plants such as chamomile, lavender, and passionflower may also be used to calm the nervous system and reduce emotional eating, while creams containing green tea extract can help to boost metabolism and promote weight loss.

preparations.preparation_desc: Curcuma longa creams have been increasingly used to treat overeating ailments due to their potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. These creams contain bioactive constituents such as curcumin, demethoxycurcumin, and bisdemethoxycurcumin, which have been shown to modulate gut-brain axis and regulate appetite hormones, helping to curb overeating. By reducing inflammation and oxidative stress in the gut, Curcuma longa creams may also aid in improving digestion and reducing symptoms of overeating, such as bloating and discomfort. The benefits of using Curcuma longa creams for overeating include reduced food cravings, improved appetite regulation, and enhanced overall gut health, making it a promising natural remedy for those struggling with overeating.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Phytomedicine: international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology", Curcuma longa creams for overeating may be beneficial in managing hypertriglyceridemia, a condition associated with high amounts of triglyceride in the blood, which can lead to complications over time.
